notes:
New Features:

- Redlight HD now prepares a warm standby child session shortly before the signed one-hour token expires, allowing the expected expiry to recover from an already validated replacement instead of resolving the website only after playback has stopped.

Improvements:

- A severely degraded Redlight startup is now detected from the combined Kodi cache, playback-lag and manifest-staleness signals and may receive one fresh direct-child handoff during the first five minutes instead of buffering repeatedly for several minutes.
- If Kodi ends while the current Redlight child manifest is still advancing, recovery now reuses that healthy session immediately instead of performing an unnecessary full website re-resolve.

Bugfixes:

- Suppresses duplicate simultaneous .com EOF recoveries caused by the player-end watcher and scheduled diagnostic tick handling the same stop at nearly the same time.
- Reduces the visible delay at the predictable Redlight token expiry by validating and reusing the prepared warm standby session when available.
- Internal planned stream handoffs are no longer misclassified by the playback watcher as manual stops.
